answer: Mechanism: PUF-gated acoustic-cavity attestation. Each agent’s token contains a physically unclonable function whose key unlocks only after a quill-mounted piezo exciter injects a raven-call challenge into a mesa-shaped cavity and the mic records the cavity’s impulse response. The token signs the joint PUF+response; enrollment rejects near-duplicate responses. Minting N sybils requires N distinct cavities and PUF tokens, each acoustically isolated and calibrated—real hardware, floor space, and per-unit variance—so one operator cannot replay one chamber into many identities.
